data.label: include
data.reason_zh: HexaShell 让 agent 依据失败日志反复改写工具代码，并将演化后的工具冻结后迁移到新布局测试，符合反馈驱动且可复用的 Harness 改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: After each failed attempt, the agent reads the log, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools.
scope_support.object_quote: After each failed attempt, the agent reads the log, finds the cause, and writes or fixes small programs called tools.
scope_support.persistence_quote: We build the tools on only ten layouts of one seed per task, then freeze them and test them on ten new layouts of the same seed.
